info.title: Ardea API
info.description: Self-hosted early warning for security vulnerabilities. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.

error.description: What went wrong, in words safe to show an administrator: no key, no prompt.

AiConnectionResult.description: The outcome of a connection test (master plan 14, task 4.1).

AiProviderInfo.description: What the administration shows of a provider: never its key, and of the endpoint only the host.

webhookInternalHosts.description: Hosts webhooks may reach in the private network, comma-separated (master plan 9.5).

InstanceStatusView.description:
The first administration (task 0.13, master plan 11.4): registration, SMTP with a test mail,
abandoned jobs with retry, the installed version. Instance administrator only.

value.description: The effective value; always null for secrets.

isSet.description: Whether a value is in effect, from the environment, the database or a default.

locked.description: Set by an environment variable: shown read-only.

StatusMetric.description: One figure of the operation, e.g. jobs waiting of a kind; counts only, never contents (master plan 9.2).

webhookInternalHosts.description: Hosts webhooks may reach in the private network, comma-separated

UpdateInstanceSettingsRequest.description: Absent fields stay unchanged; an empty string removes a stored value.
